text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer runs in the Japanese Derby. Mejiro Ryan is extremely motivated for the race, but there's someone else even more determined than her…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's another front runner named Ines Fujin. Mejiro Palmer exchanges simple greetings with her before the race, but this only serves to get Ines even more fired up. And so, the heated race begins.
